Explain why atomic individual loads alone do not provide a coherent transaction.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Introduce a retryable callback with a synthetic log effect: stage it for commit or supply compensation rather than replaying it blindly. rubric.criterion: Derive snapshot validation, write-set locking, abort restoration and the distinction between transaction isolation, atomic C accesses and memory reclamation; explain inconsistent-read hazards before commit.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: For five-byte uint32 varints require the final payload<=15 and no continuation. objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Implement the T20.03 functional-core boundary: explicit state and recorded input produce new state and effect requests, while an adapter owns effects. Demonstrate rollback equivalence without replaying externally visible effects or claiming that ordinary C enforces purity.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Prove determinism from complete state/input and defined unsigned arithmetic. Identify every effect boundary and distinguish speculative requests from committed presentation. Derive rollback of the HAMT used cursor after a failed second update while preserving old reachable roots; staged unreachable arena cells and allocation counters may differ. All arena users must be quiescent during the transaction, and roots from unpublished intermediate updates must never escape. Score overflow or invalid movement must not partially publish a state/effect.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Run replicated.replay and exhaustively compare all movement histories of length0..8 with a Python integer model; verify suffix rollback versus full replay. Kill omitted random-score contribution and failed second-update allocation-leak mutants. Build a synthetic effect adapter with idempotency key(timeline,tick) and injected failure; record one duplicate-effect counterexample if replay directly invokes the adapter. Inspect undefined symbols to confirm the core has no time/random/I/O dependency.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Introduce two local simulated players, predicted remote inputs and delayed corrections using ipc.local/io.frame, with bounded rollback horizon and retained snapshots. Separate authoritative committed effects from speculative presentation and define replacement/cancellation semantics. Reuse the actual T20.03 learner reducer adapter and storage.pages snapshot backend, then vary compiler/endianness and compare canonical state hashes. Implement a hidden wall-clock/random dependency as a deliberately failing counterexample, not a production change.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.
